description: This northeastern China collection estimates soil erosion by water at 250-metre resolution for 2001–2020. Beijing Normal University and partner researchers combine remote-sensing inputs with alternative RUSLE factor calculations on Google Earth Engine, selecting combinations against hydrological-station evidence. ScienceDB assigns CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for free access, although its inspected metadata does not identify the delivered raster format. The estimates can support sediment-pressure and land-degradation assumptions in reservoir or green-infrastructure simulations. Modelled erosion is not a direct measurement of sediment arriving at an individual structure, and uncertainty in factors and routing remains consequential. Coverage is regional, not a survey of engineering assets. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Soil Water Erosion Dataset of Northeast China from 2001 to 2020
